title: factdiff.py anchor --file F --lines N --propose prints the proposals for those lines
goal: factdiff.py anchor with --file, --lines and --propose is not refused as a usage error and writes nothing; it prints the line,source,quote rows of those lines only

run:
import subprocess as s,sys
p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/factdiff.py","anchor","--file","kb/public/auth/enrolment-tokens.md","--lines","18","--propose"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
o=p.stdout+p.stderr;print(p.returncode,o[-200:])
sys.exit(0 if "no --propose" not in o and p.returncode in (0,1) else 1)

import csv,io,subprocess as s,sys
st=lambda:s.run(["git","status","--porcelain"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
a=st();p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/factdiff.py","anchor","--file","kb/public/auth/enrolment-tokens.md","--lines","18","--propose"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300);b=st()
o=p.stdout;i=o.find("line,source,quote")
rows=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(o[i:])))[1:] if i>=0 else []
lines={r[0] for r in rows}
print(p.returncode,len(rows),sorted(lines),a==b,(p.stdout+p.stderr)[-120:])
sys.exit(0 if a==b and "no --propose" not in p.stdout+p.stderr and ((i<0 and p.returncode==1) or (i>=0 and rows and lines=={"18"})) else 1)

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: factdiff.py anchor --file ... --lines N --propose was refused 11 times in 7 days, all by research workers (last 2026-10-24T12:41Z), each with the usage dump '--lines needs exactly one --file and no other selector and no --propose' (factdiff.py:2691); all 11 usage errors of anchor have this message. The parser help already says --lines anchors only the facts on those lines and --propose prints the passages, so a worker combines them. Goal for the worker: --propose with --lines prints the line,source,quote rows of those lines only. The planted run reads the cached documents of the cited sources (network when they are missing), so it accepts exit 0 or 1 and fails only on the refusal.
